Dear FC Collins team,

I'm excited to apply for the Social Media & Content Contributor role for the 2026/27 season. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and web management, I'm drawn to FC Collins's unique approach—building the brand before the results. Your motto 'more than a club, more than a game' resonates with me.

I've managed WordPress sites, created SEO-driven content, and integrated social media for projects like mirook.com. I'm comfortable with Canva, have an eye for photography, and can edit short videos. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can be in Knokke-Heist for match days.

I'm keen to bring fresh ideas, spot trends, and contribute to match day content, creative concepts, and LinkedIn presence. I'm eager to learn and not shy about pitching ideas.

I've attached my CV and a few examples of my work. I'd love to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear FC Collins team,

When I read that FC Collins built the brand before the results, I knew this was a club I wanted to be part of. Your approach—content quality and community first—is exactly how I think about digital presence. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content, I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to your week-to-week social media, website, and LinkedIn.

In my current role at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I've also developed mirook.com from scratch, where I implemented structured data and social media integration to boost visibility. These experiences have given me a solid grasp of content management, social media coordination, and performance tracking—skills that align with your needs.

I'm comfortable with Canva, have an eye for photography, and can edit short videos to create engaging reels. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and can be present at home matches in Knokke-Heist. I'm eager to bring fresh ideas, spot trends, and contribute to creative concepts that push the brand forward.

What excites me most is the chance to work with a club that naturally attracts attention and to collaborate with Cozy Dreams on brand campaigns. I'm keen to learn, not shy about pitching ideas, and ready to take full ownership of channels.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to the 2026/27 season. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
